description: Every process leaves a trail, invoices moving toward payment, cases working through approval, tickets passing from desk to desk. Most teams only ever see where that trail ends. This custom visual shows you the whole path. Feed it your event log and get back a live flowchart of how your process actually runs: which steps come first, which paths cases really take, and where things slow down or double back. No process modeling expertise required. No manual mapping. Just a clear, honest picture of your operations, built from your own data. Use it to spot where cases get stuck, which step is quietly running long, where work is being redone that shouldn't be, and how the process shifts across vendors, regions, or teams. The kind of visibility that used to take a consultant and a whiteboard now takes minutes. Drops straight into any Power BI report, no extra setup, no data to move. Brought to you by BI Book. Optional NetSuite integration: if you set an Account ID in the Format pane, and your Case ID values correspond to NetSuite vendor-bill record IDs, an "Open in NetSuite" link appears when viewing a case, taking you directly to that record in NetSuite. This is entirelnd only activates when a user clicks the link — it does not transmit any reportdata to NetSuite or any other external service.
